newsitem.title: USA: Electric & Gas to sell unit for $21.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Electric & Gas to sell unit for $21.5 mln.

text.p: Electric & Gas Technology Inc said Wednesday it has an agreement to sell its Logic Design Metals Inc unit to an affiliate of Kidd & Co LLC for about $21.5 million in cash.
The transaction is subject to the arrangement of financing by the buyer, Chatam Technologies Inc.
Electric & Gas said it will continue to own and operate its four other business segments: electrical, defense, gas and plastics.
"This will set the stage for a major opportunity for corporate growth with substantial financial strength," company chairman S. Mort Zimmerman said in a written statement.
The company "now will be in a position to accelerate its focus on the multi-billion dollar international water market," senior vice president Daniel Zimmerman said.
It will will expand its development, manufacturing and marketing of water related products through internal development as well as implementing an aggressive acquisition strategy, the company said.
The company will be offering a family of products which generates bottled quality water directly from the atmosphere, it said.
